title: Glowing rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd0dc' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd0dc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petal' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fab'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e63e6d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a81e4c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='center' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff1a8'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e86a2c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 58 C49 70 51 82 50 94' stroke='#3fa34d' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 C49 70 51 82 50 94' stroke='#7fe08a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaves -->
  <path d='M50 74 C38 68 30 72 28 80 C38 84 46 82 50 74 Z' fill='#4cbf5a'/>
  <path d='M50 74 C38 68 30 72 28 80 C38 84 46 82 50 74 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8cf09a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M50 64 C62 60 70 64 72 72 C62 76 54 74 50 64 Z' fill='#3fa34d'/>
  <path d='M50 64 C62 60 70 64 72 72 C62 76 54 74 50 64 Z' fill='none' stroke='#7fe08a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='13' ry='14' fill='url(#petal)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='36' rx='13' ry='12' fill='url(#petal)' transform='rotate(-40 31 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='36' rx='13' ry='12' fill='url(#petal)' transform='rotate(40 69 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='52' rx='13' ry='12' fill='url(#petal)' transform='rotate(35 36 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='52' rx='13' ry='12' fill='url(#petal)' transform='rotate(-35 64 52)'/>

  <!-- middle petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#ff6f94'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#fb5d87' transform='rotate(-35 38 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#fb5d87' transform='rotate(35 62 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f24d7b'/>

  <!-- inner swirl -->
  <path d='M50 34 C56 34 58 41 53 45 C48 49 43 45 44 40 C45 36 50 36 51 39' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- glowing center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='41' r='5' fill='url(#center)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='41' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='56' r='1.3' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
</svg>
